label.purpose: Learning-kit form labels and compact metadata; form labels use weight 600, source links regular weight with line-height 1.7.

section-heading.purpose: Learning-kit result heading, distinct from the smaller panel and resource-group title role; inherits the shell body line-height.

display.purpose: Primary student greeting; 36px at intermediate widths and 34px on mobile.

body.purpose: Default body text below desktop widths; supporting labels use smaller sizes.

desktop-body.purpose: 14px body from 1000px; meaningful metadata 12–13px, request titles 14px, status chips 11px. Defined by campus-desktop.css.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Soft modal elevation; ordinary lists use tonal surfaces and separators.

motion.name: destination-marker
motion.purpose: Scale active marker from .5 to 1 only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable animation and transitions when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Discovery Surface
components.description: Apple green area for finding resources.
components.html: Bạn đang tìm gì?
components.css: .ds-discovery{padding:25px 27px 21px;background:var(--campus-green,#8ed462);color:var(--ink,#2c2e2a);border-radius:16px}.ds-discovery h2{margin:0;font:800 25px/1.35 Manrope,'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:23px;margin-top:19px;border-bottom:1px solid #5f973e}.ds-tabs button{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:0 0 11px;min-height:36px;color:#2f4826;font:400 12px 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif}.ds-tabs .ds-selected{color:var(--ink,#2c2e2a);border-color:var(--ink,#2c2e2a);font-weight:700}.ds-tabs button:hover{border-color:#496d35}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal,#365c2a);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Goal Disclosure
components.description: Native learning-kit disclosure with a visible goal label; expanded content uses the quiet reading surface.
components.html: Bộ học liệu theo mục tiêuMột mục tiêu cụ thể. Những cuốn sách phù hợp.
components.css: .ds-goal{background:var(--white,#fffdf7);color:var(--ink,#2c2e2a);border:1px solid var(--line,#d8dacb);border-radius:14px;font:400 14px/1.65 var(--font-body,'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif)}.ds-goal-summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 25px;list-style:none}.ds-goal-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-goal-summary strong{display:block;font:700 18px/1.65 var(--font-heading,Manrope,'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif)}.ds-goal-summary span span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#62665a);margin-top:5px}.ds-goal[open]>.ds-goal-summary{background:var(--paper-deep,#e9eadb);border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d8dacb)}.ds-goal-icon{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8}.ds-goal[open] .ds-goal-icon{rotate:45deg}.ds-goal-content{padding:25px}.ds-goal-label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.ds-goal-input{padding:11px 13px;min-height:85px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid var(--line,#d8dacb);border-radius:8px;background:var(--white,#fffdf7);color:var(--ink,#2c2e2a);font:400 13px/1.75 var(--font-body,'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif);caret-color:var(--teal,#365c2a)}.ds-goal-input:focus{border-color:var(--teal,#365c2a)}.ds-goal-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#62665a);opacity:1}.ds-goal-summary:hover{cursor:pointer}.ds-goal-summary:focus-visible,.ds-goal-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal,#365c2a);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: Apple green discovery surfaces sit on warm cream, with ink navigation and quiet ruled lists. Manrope headings and Be Vietnam Pro body copy give the workspace a welcoming, readable character. Color draws attention to finding resources while personal activity remains compact.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navigation with a circular green destination marker.
Rounded controls and quiet ruled activity lists.

rules.name: The Purposeful Green Rule
rules.body: Use campus green for discovery and destination cues; keep long reading areas on paper or white.

dos: Do pair Manrope headings with Be Vietnam Pro body copy.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do distinguish discovery surfaces from quiet reading areas.
donts: Don't turn every activity row into an elevated card.
Don't replace the green destination marker with an unlabeled navigation state.
